## Profile

Communications and media professional with experience in public affairs,
journalism, technical writing, broadcasting, and digital media. Previous work
includes a communications role with the Department of Foreign Affairs' Office
of the Undersecretary for Migrant Workers' Affairs, editorial and broadcast
work, and the coordination of a public-service initiative during the COVID-19
pandemic.

Academic training includes a First Class Honours degree in Mathematics from
the University of Bristol, with work in statistical machine learning,
artificial neural networks, mathematical programming, and computational
topology. The final-year
project examined the computational stability of topological methods for
retinal images using mathematical analysis, Python, and machine-learning
experiments.
